mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, reducing flecainide plasma concentrations and potentially decreasing antiarrhythmic efficacy; both agents have cardiac effects including QT prolongation and negative inotropic properties.
action: Monitor flecainide efficacy and cardiac function closely; consider flecainide dose adjustment or alternative antiarrhythmic if therapeutic levels cannot be maintained; obtain baseline and periodic ECGs.
